(~eti; Mp III 252,.12 : pīnaṃ thūlaṃ karoti, Ce, Ee so; Be pīṇitam; Se pīṇaṃ); D III 130,.32 (ekacco bālo pāṇe vadhitvā attānaṃ sukheti ~eti); Ja III 313,11* (laddho piṇḍo na ~eti kiso ten’ asmi vaṭṭaka; 313,17´ : na tappeti); Vism 143,.14 (~ayatī ti pīti, sā … kāyacittapīṇanarasā, Be, Ce so; Ee pīṇāyatī ti; Se pīnayatī ti) = Sp 145,.6 (Ce so; Be pinayatī ti; Ee, Se pīnayatī ti) = As 115,.28 (Ce, Ee, Se so; Be piṇayatī ti); Sv 40,.22 (migapakkhīnaṃ pi cakkhūni ~ayati pag eva devamanussānaṃ); 626,.18 (dissamānā va cakkhūni ~ayati, Ee so; Be piṇayati; Ce pīnayati; Se milāyati) = Ps IV 227,.12 (Be, Se so; Ce, Ee pīnayati); Mp IV 178,.24 (seṭṭhissa cittaṃ na ~eti); As 403,.14 (susiniddhehi macchamaṃsādīhi sarīraṃ ~enti, Ce, Se so; Be sarīramaṃsaṃ ~enti; Ee pīnenti); Sadd 499,.16 (idaṃ pana hetukattuvasena pīnayatī ti pīti, tappetī ti attho); — part.pr. pīṇenta, mfn., Pv-a 283,.17 (attānaṃ sukhento ~ento); Ap-a 518,.8 (santappayanto ~ento); — aor. 3 sg. pīṇesi, Ja III 145,4´ (taṃ kathaṃ idaṃ sāmākanīvāraṃ aloṇaṃ ~esi tosesi, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se ~eti toseti); Bv-a 216,.18 (tappayī ti atappayi, ~esī ti attho); — inf. pīṇetuṃ, M II 191,.28 (kāyaṃ c’ eva ~etuṃ brūhetuṃ); —       pp    pīṇita, mfn. [S. prīṇita], pleased, gladdened; satisfied; invigorated, made strong; Vv 16:13 (muditaman’ amhi ~ā; Vv-a 86,.5 : tuṭṭhā pītirasavasena vā tittā); Pv 20:7 (yadi atthi hetu yena tuvaṃ cirataraṃ ~o siyā); Ja V 311,20* (~ā tena lābhena tuṭṭhā; 311,28´ : ~ā ti santappitā); Mil 249,.14 (subhuttā tittā suhitā dhātā ~ā paripuṇṇā); Vism 365,.15; Sv 157,.28 (pīṇentī ti ~aṃ thāmabalūpetaṃ karonti); Ps II 238,.23 (tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ balavasomanassavasena cittaṃ ~aṃ hoti); Paṭis-a 545,.33 (pītiyā ~-ttā kāyacittapassaddhi uppajjati); Mhv 18:59; — pīṇitabhojana- in Ee at Mp V 28,.23 is wr for paṇītabhojana- (Be, Ce, Se so); — ~’-indriya, mfn., with invigorated, perfect sense-faculties; with senses in good condition; M II 121,.21 (bhikkhū passāmi haṭṭhapahaṭṭhe … ~’-indriye Ce, Ee so; Be pīṇindriye; Se piṇindriye); Dhp-a IV 11,.7 (sañjātabalo ~’-indriyo, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se pīṇindriyo); Pv-a 23,.11 (te tāni paribhuñjitvā ~’-indriyā ahesuṃ, Ce so; Be, Ee pīṇindriyā; Ee pi nindiyā); 46,.6 (sā petī suhitā ~’-indriyā dibbāhārassa tittā ahosi, Ce, Ee pīṇindriyā); Ja I 81,.28 (samaṇo Gotamo paccayabāhullāya āvattitvā paripuṇṇakāyo ~’-indriyo suvaṇṇavaṇṇo hutvā āgacchati, Ce so; Be pīṇindriyo; Ee phītindriyo; Se piṇindriyo) = Ap-a 86,.20 (Ce, Ee so; Be, Se pīṇindriyo); Mhv 37:168 (ñatvā taṃ … sukhitaṃ ~’-indriyaṃ); — see also pīnindriya (sv pīna); — atipīṇita, mfn., in too good condition; Dhp-a I 70,.19 (atipīṇitaṃ etaṃ rūpaṃ suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se atipaṇītaṃ); — supīṇita, mfn., very pleased, very glad; Ap 477,.9; — fpp pīṇetabba, mfn., M II 186,.27 (ayaṃ ca kāyo pīṇetabbo brūhetabbo ti); Cp-a 162,.24 (attā pīṇetabbo); — see also pināti.
saputta:
putta
putra m. (pl. nom./acc. ~e ~āni) [S. putra], 1. a son (of men or birds or animals); pl. also sons and daughters, children; Abh 240; 249 (~ā tu puttadhītaro); Vin I 83,.13 (na bhikkhave ananuññāto mātāpitūhi ~o pabbājetabbo); 147,.22 (ahaṃ hi gilānā āgacchatu me ~o icchāmi ~assa āgatan ti); III 26,.7 (~o me atthi so mayā posetabbo ti); 66,.35 (~o kho āvuso pituno dāyajjo ti); D I 135,.27 (manussā ca mudā modamānā ure ~e naccentā apārutagharā maññe viharissantī ti); II 272,.7 (Sakkassa devānam indassa °-ttaṃ ajjhūpagatā); III 189,.5 (pañcahi … ṭhānehi ~ena puratthimā disā mātāpitaro paccupaṭṭhātabbā); M I 333,.8 (tassa me Kāḷī nāma bhaginī tassā tvaṃ ~o so me tvaṃ bhāgineyyo hosi); S I 42,16* (~o pavadataṃ varo; Spk I 98,.20 : rājakulamajjhādīsu pavadantānaṃ ~o varo, so hi mātāpitūnaṃ anatthāvahaṃ na vadati); 210,12* (piyo loke sako ~o); A III 43,22* (pañcaṭṭhānāni sampassaṃ ~am icchanti paṇḍitā); 44,3* (ovādakārī bhataposī kulavaṃsaṃ ahāpayaṃ saddho sīlena sampanno ~o hoti pasaṃsiyo); 148,.24 (pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño cakkavattissa jeṭṭho ~o pitarā pavattitaṃ cakkaṃ dhammen’ eva anupavatteti); Dhp 288 (na santi ~ā tāṇāya); Ud 5,.29 (eso te samaṇa ~o posa nan ti); 17,.33 (iccheyyāmāhaṃ bhagavā aññāni pi evarūpāni satta ~ānī ti; Ud-a 157,.11 foll.: aññe pi evarūpe satta ~e ti vattabbe liṅgavipallāsena vuttaṃ); It 62,.20 (tayo ’me bhikkhave ~ā … atijāto anujāto avajāto ti); Sn 35 (na ~am iccheyya kuto sahāyaṃ eko care khaggavisāṇakappo); 38 (~esu dāresu ca yā apekhā; Pj II 76,.5 : puttadhītubhariyāsu); 149 (mātā yathā niyaṃ ~aṃ āyusā ekaputtam anurakkhe); 255 (yasmiṃ ca seti urasīva ~o sa ve mitto); 858 (na tassa ~ā pasavo khettaṃ vatthuṃ ca vijjati, so read with Be, Ce, Se); Vv 83:11 (ko vā tvaṃ kassa vā ~o kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayaṃ); Pv 6:3 (pañca ~āni … vijāyitvāna); 42:5 (thaṇḍile pattaṃ bhinditvā hasamāno apakkami rañño Kitavass’ ahaṃ ~o, kiṃ maṃ bhikkhu karissasi); Th 475 (kicchā laddho ayaṃ ~o … imaṃ dadāma te nātha); Thī 312 (petāni bhoti ~āni khādamānā tuvaṃ pure); Ja II 19,.4 (tassa pana hatthissa ~o sabbaseto hatthājānīyapotako atthi); 39,.12 (apare pan’ assa dve haṃsapotakā ~ā ahesuṃ); III 50,13* (tātā ti ~o vadamāno kampeti hadayaṃ pitu); V 279,.13 (avassaṃ ettikāsu itthīsu ekā puññavatī ~aṃ labhissatī ti); 509,22* (na te ~ā ye na bharanti jiṇṇaṃ); VI 133,2* (~ehi deva yajitabbaṃ; 133,6´ : attano jātehi piyaputtehi c’ eva piyadhītāhi ca); 290,14* (āmantaya vammadharāni … ~āni; 290,20´ : mama ~e ca dhītaro ca); 380,21* (puttass’ āvikareyya guyham atthaṃ); 528,23* (yattha Vessantaro rājā saha ~ehi sammati); Nidd I 247,.31 foll. (cattāro ~ā attajo ~o khettajo ~o dinnako ~o antevāsiko ~o); Ap 330,.29 (bhariyā me kālakatā ~o sīvathikaṃ gato); 355,.13 (kiṃ me ~ehi dārehi rajjena sakalena ca); Cp 3:2:1 (kāmito dayito ~o); Mil 75,.14 foll. (api ca mātusadiso vā ~o hoti mātupakkho vā pitusadiso vā ~o hoti pitupakkho vā ti); 287,.29 (~ā mahārāja loke bandhanaṃ); Vism 567,.27 (pitito nāmavasena ~o); Mp I 258,.8 (Rāhulasāmaṇero pitu anucchaviko ~o ti); 399,.7 (rūpūpajīviniyo ca nāma vijātakāle sace ~o hoti chaḍḍenti sace dhītā jagganti); Dhp-a I 88,.25 (Upatissagāmake jeṭṭhakulassa °-ttā Upatisso ti nāmaṃ kariṃsu); II 273,.17 (yassa gehe ~o vā dhītā vā na koci matapubbo ti); Ud-a 276,.14 (vijātamātuyā nāma virūpo pi ~o surūpo viya manāpo hoti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee piyamanāpo hoti); Pj II 79,.3 (deva kulavaṃsānupālako ~o icchitabbo attaje avijjamāne khettajo pi kulavaṃsadharo hotī ti); Th-a III 127,.13 (rañño ekā dhītā va atthi ~o natthi, arājakaṃ rajjaṃ nassati, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee arājikaṃ rajjaṃ na nandati); Nidd-a I 258,.3 (puṃ tāyati rakkhatī ti ~o); Sadd 402,.11 foll. (pū pavane: pavati ~o … attano kulaṃ pavati sodhetī ti ~o); 499,.6 (attano pitu hadayaṃ pūretī ti ~o); 870,.29 (putro); Mhv 22:35 (patthehi mama °-ttaṃ); — ifc see anujāta-, ayya-, kula-, du- (duputta2 sv du2), pitā- (sv pita[r]), pitucchā-, mātucchā-, mātula-, rāja- (sv rāja[n]); — 2. one who is like a son, regarded as a son; one who regards himself as a son; D II 243,23* (tvaṃ pitā si ahaṃ ~o, mā no Govinda pājahi; Sv 667,.5 : tvaṃ pitiṭṭhāne ṭhassati ahaṃ °-ṭṭhāne); III 81,.13 (brāhmaṇā va brahmuno ~ā orasā mukhato jātā); S I 192,5* (sabbe bhagavato ~ā palāp’ ettha na vijjati) = Th 1237; S III 83,23* (pasaṃsiyā sappurisā ~ā buddhassa orasā); Th 41 (jhāyati ~o appaṭimassa tādino); 348 (suddho suddhassa dāyādo ~o buddhassa oraso); 889 (brahmajacco pure āsiṃ … so ’jja ~o sugatassa dhammarājassa satthuno); Thī 63 (~o buddhassa dāyādo Kassapo susamāhito); Ja III 211,.6 (bhikkhave tumhe mayhaṃ orasā mukhato jātā ~ā nāma); Ap 45,.10 (vijahitvāna taṃ jātiṃ ~o jāto mahesino); Sp 977,.10 foll. (°-cittaṃ upaṭṭhapessatī ti ~o me ayan ti evaṃ gehasitapemavasena cittaṃ upaṭṭhapessati); Dhp-a IV 231,.15 (satthā na bhikkhave mama ~o Aṅgulimālo bhāyati … ti vatvā); — 3. a member of a group; a follower; an apprentice; — ifc see ugga- (sv ugga2), kammāra-, dāsa- (sv dāsa1), dāsaka-, nigaṇṭha-, para-, ludda-, sakya-; —      °-kate, for the sake of the child; Thī 303 (na maṃ ~e jammi puna-r-āvattayissasi, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be °-katte; Thī-a 214,.33 : ~e ti °-kāraṇā, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se °-katte ti); —       °-khādinī, (m) f (n)., who eats her children; Thī-a 219,.21 (loke hi yassā itthiyā jātajātā puttā maranti taṃ garahantā ~inī ti ādiṃ vadanti); — ifc see pañca-; —       °-giddhi(n), mfn., loving, eagerly longing for, one’s son; Ja VI 584,1* (pitaraṃ ~inaṃ); Vism 665,.14 (ekā kira ~inī itthī); —       °-jīva, m., a kind of tree (Putranjiva Roxburghii?); Ja VI 530,4* (~ā ca kakudhā; 531,7´ : ~ā ti mahānigrodhā, Be so; Se mahānigrodharukkhā; Ce, Ee omit); —       °-dāra, m.n. sg. and pl., wife and children; wives and children; Abh 421 (mahāpariccāgo … ~ānaṃ); Vin III 244,.32 (attanā pi na yāpeti ~ā pi ’ssa kilamanti); IV 104,.21 (ye mayaṃ ājīvassa hetu ~assa kāraṇā senāya āgacchāmā ti); D III 66,.4 (~aṃ ca posehi); 192,1* (~ā disā pacchā); A I 206,.22 foll. (jānāti kho pan’ assa ~o ayaṃ mayhaṃ bhattā ti so pi jānāti ayaṃ mayhaṃ ~o ti); Khp 5:5 (mātāpitu-upaṭṭhānaṃ ~assa saṅgaho; Pj I 138,.8 : attano jātā puttā pi dhītaro pi puttā tv eva saṅkhaṃ gacchanti dārā ti vīsatiyā bhariyānaṃ yā kāci bhariyā, puttā ca dārā ca ~aṃ) = Sn 262; Thī 112 (~āni posentā dhanaṃ vindanti māṇavā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee mānavā); Ja VI 136,.15 (ayye putto vo ~e māretvā yaññaṃ yajitukāmo ti); 511,4* (Vessantaro rājā … ādāya ~aṃ ca Vaṅkaṃ pāyāsi pabbataṃ); Vism 502,13* (vippavāsasatādīnaṃ ~ehi attano); Mil 274,.21 foll. (bhante Nāgasena, sabbe va bodhisattā ~aṃ denti, udāhu Vessantaren’ eva raññā ~aṃ dinnan ti); Sv 850,.20 (antojanasaṅkhātaṃ tava ~aṃ sīlasaṃvare patiṭṭhāpehi); — saputtadāra, m (fn)., with one’s wife and children; Vin III 160,.29; M II 167,.20; Pv 38:48; Ja V 219,17* (dāso ahaṃ tuyha saputtadāro); —       °-naṭṭha, mfn., deprived of his son; who has lost his son; Ja II 183,10* (dehi ~a phālanaṭṭhassa phālaṃ; 183,24´ : ambho naṭṭhaputtapurisa); —       °-natta, iic, [putta + natta(r)], sons and grandsons; Sp 100,.20 (~-paramparāya); Dhp-a I 408,.7 (~-panattasantānavasena); 416,.13 (~-parivutā); —       °-nattakā, m.pl., sons and grandsons; Sp 1011,.1 (~esu); Spk III 32,.30 (~ānaṃ dārakānaṃ pacchato caritabbaṃ hoti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee pūtigandhakānaṃ pacchato caritabbo hoti, perhaps wr); —       °-paputtakā, m.pl., sons and grandsons; M II 78,.8 (Ps III 312,.13 : puttā ca puttaputtā cā ti); Mhv 2:5; —       °-pema, n., affection, love, for a son, for one’s child; Vin I 82,.38 (~aṃ bhante chaviṃ chindati); Ja IV 36,7* (~ā na idha par’ atthi kiñci); Ap 532,.18 (paṇāmaṃ te karissaṃ ~asā, Ce, Ee so; Be putta-uttame; Se puttapemahaṃ); 555,.22 (me ~asā); Mp III 310,.8 (dhītaraṃ vā puttaṃ vā jātaṃ disvā ~aṃ puttassādo uppajjati); —       °-matā, (m) f (n)., one whose children are (as good as) dead; M I 524,.1 (ime pan’ ājīvikā ~āya puttā; Ps III 235,.6 : ājīvikā matā nāma tesaṃ mātā ~ā hoti); — see °-hata below; —       °-matta, m., like a son; who is the age or has the status of one’s son; M I 460,.14 (ime pan’ amhākaṃ ~ā maññe nattamattā maññe) = A II 124,.5; Ja VI 433,27´; —       °-va(t), mf (n)., who has a son or sons or children; S IV 249,.12 (°-vatī assan ti); Thī 300 (maṃ °-vatiṃ santiṃ kassa ohāya gacchasi); Pj II 44,.14 (°-vā puggalo); —       °-sañjīvana, mfn., making my son live; Ap 566,.6 (avocaṃ dehi bhesajjaṃ ~an ti bho); —       °-sama, mfn., equal to (that for) a son; S I 6,17* (natthi ~aṃ pemaṃ; Spk I 32,.29 foll.: virūpe pi hi attano puttake suvaṇṇabimbakaṃ viya maññati … °-pemena samaṃ pemaṃ nāma natthī ti vuttaṃ hoti); —       °-hata, mfn., whose children are (as good as) dead; Ja I 355,8* (athāgamā ~āya putto; 355,13´ : hataputtāya putto nillajjo ti attho); Spk I 338,.18 (gaṇhatha ~āya putte ti, Be, Ce so; Se °-matāya; Ee suttahatāya sutte ti) = 346,.19 (Be, Ce so; Se °-matāya; Ee suttahatāya sutte ti); —     aputta, m., not a son; not an heir; Ja V 468,.6 (atha naṃ vinicchayaṃ netvā ~-bhāvaṃ katvā nīharāpesi); VI 472,3´ (ahaṃ tava puttaṃ ca ~aṃ ca jānāmi); Sv 953,.7 (mātāpitaro … micchāpaṭipanne dārake vinicchayaṃ patvā ~e karonti, Be, Se so; Ce aputtake; Ee aputtakaṃ) ≠ Spk III 160,.34 (ayaṃ amhākaṃ ~o ti paribāhiraṃ karonti) = Mp II 65,.6; Mp I 429,.1 (esa taṃ ~aṃ karissāmī ti pakkosati, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee aputtakaṃ); Sadd 587,.17 (~aṃ puttam iva ācarati puttīyati); —      duputta,   dupputta, m., a bad son; Vism 494,.28 (kucchitaṃ hi puttaṃ dupputto ti vadanti) = Paṭis-a 54,.27 (duputto ti) = Vibh-a 84,.3 (duputto ti); —      niputta, mf (n)., without children, childless; Thī-a 182,.25 (ahaṃ bahuputtā hutvā ~ā jātā ti); —     saputta, mf (n)., with one’s son(s); with one’s children; D I 110,.23 (esāhaṃ … ~o sabhariyo sapariso …); Ja II 29,.24 (~āya tāya saddhiṃ samaggavāsaṃ vasi); IV 147,.28 (ten’ assā ahaṃ ~āya parihāraṃ acchinditvā); VI 175,5*; Dhp-a I 48,.8 (~aṃ taṃ khādituṃ labheyyan ti, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se saputtakaṃ); Ud-a 127,.12 (bhagavā ~āya mātuyā arogabhāvaṃ āsiṃsanto, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee sahaputtāya tassā); — see also atraja, antevāsika, aputtaka1, ekaputtikā (sv eka), khettaja, dinnaka, nipputtaka, sakyaputtiya (sv sakya), saputtaka1.
subuddha:
buddha
mfn., m., and n. [ts; pp of bujjhati1 qv], 1. (mfn.)
